ui_bugs.issue: data-testid values are NOT unique per row: every ComplaintRow renders the same 'complaint-row', 'complaint-called-btn', 'complaint-resolve-btn', 'complaint-called-tag', 'complaint-review-tag'. Spec suggests per-row scoping (e.g. complaint-called-btn-{id}); duplicate testids make it impossible to assert on a specific row via a single selector. Functionality works, but tests must rely on nth-index or DOM traversal.
